source.book: Enterprise Architecture as Strategy with ggen

thesis: Enterprise architecture becomes strategy when admitted architectural knowledge governs the complete family of operational consequences required to realize the operating model.
final_law: The architecture may generate every lawful consequence of admitted knowledge, but no consequence may outrank its authority or evidence.

dimensions.title: Strategic intent and measurable outcome
dimensions.law: Every initiative binds drivers, outcomes, measures, claim ceiling, exclusions, and falsifier.
proof_obligations: Positive: admit an initiative with linked driver, outcome, measure, owner, and bounded claim.
Negative: refuse an initiative whose target claim exceeds its authorized scope.
Replay: regenerate the initiative burden of proof from the same admitted strategy state.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse an initiative whose target claim exceeds its authorized scope.

dimensions.title: Operating-model choice
dimensions.law: Integration and standardization requirements select Diversification, Coordination, Replication, or Unification without defaulting to centralization.
proof_obligations: Positive: project the selected quadrant and its required shared/local consequences.
Negative: refuse a platform mandate inconsistent with the admitted operating model.
Replay: reproduce the quadrant classification and affected organizational boundaries.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse a platform mandate inconsistent with the admitted operating model.

dimensions.title: Core-diagram closure
dimensions.law: The core diagram is generated from the graph and exposes core processes, shared information, reusable services, integration mechanisms, and consumers.
proof_obligations: Positive: generate a core diagram whose nodes resolve to canonical graph identities.
Negative: detect a diagram element with no graph authority or realization.
Replay: regenerate a byte-identical or semantically identical view from the same graph.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: detect a diagram element with no graph authority or realization.

dimensions.title: Capability and value-stream traceability
dimensions.law: Capabilities and value streams connect strategy to products, services, owners, consumers, and evidence.
proof_obligations: Positive: traverse one outcome through capability, value stream, service, and operating evidence.
Negative: expose an orphan or duplicated capability relation.
Replay: reproduce the trace and dominant gap from the same architecture snapshot.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: expose an orphan or duplicated capability relation.

dimensions.title: Semantic information authority
dimensions.law: Shared information concepts have ontology identity, steward, quality, lifecycle, classification, and compatibility law.
proof_obligations: Positive: admit a shared information concept and generate consumer contracts.
Negative: refuse an unowned or incompatible semantic mutation.
Replay: reproduce ontology closure and semantic migration obligations.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse an unowned or incompatible semantic mutation.

dimensions.title: Application and service realization
dimensions.law: Application services realize information and business capabilities through explicit interfaces and consumers.
proof_obligations: Positive: show a capability realized by an application service and solution building block.
Negative: detect an application with no capability relationship or consumer.
Replay: regenerate the realization and interface view from canonical identity.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: detect an application with no capability relationship or consumer.

dimensions.title: Technology and runtime platform
dimensions.law: Technology standards declare runtime, environment, deployment, protocol, security boundary, and operating envelope.
proof_obligations: Positive: validate one realization against its declared platform profile.
Negative: refuse a realization outside capacity or technology policy.
Replay: reproduce environment-specific validation under the same profile.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse a realization outside capacity or technology policy.

dimensions.title: Reusable digitized platform
dimensions.law: Shared data, infrastructure, applications, and modules form a reusable platform aligned to the operating model.
proof_obligations: Positive: demonstrate real consumer reuse of a platform module.
Negative: expose a platform service with no consumers or hidden manual repair.
Replay: reproduce consumer onboarding and conformance evidence.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: expose a platform service with no consumers or hidden manual repair.

dimensions.title: Engagement model
dimensions.law: Projects and products interact with architecture, platform, security, operations, finance, and compliance through explicit rules.
proof_obligations: Positive: project a work order with complete engagement roles and escalation path.
Negative: refuse work that bypasses required authority or exception review.
Replay: regenerate the engagement obligations from the initiative and contracts.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse work that bypasses required authority or exception review.

dimensions.title: Decision rights and segregation of duties
dimensions.law: Decision ownership, approval authority, verification, promotion, and execution remain distinct where risk requires separation.
proof_obligations: Positive: execute a promotion with distinct proposer, verifier, approver, and broker roles.
Negative: refuse self-approval or self-certification across a protected boundary.
Replay: reproduce the decision ledger and role checks for the same promotion.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse self-approval or self-certification across a protected boundary.

dimensions.title: Federated architecture repository
dimensions.law: The repository joins source systems while preserving identity, provenance, authority, lifecycle, and snapshots.
proof_obligations: Positive: join repository, ontology, pack, capability, and receipt data without identity loss.
Negative: refuse a merge that erases provenance or creates ambiguous identity.
Replay: reconstruct the same architecture snapshot from recorded sources.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse a merge that erases provenance or creates ambiguous identity.

dimensions.title: Identity, provenance, and lifecycle
dimensions.law: Every material object exposes stable identity, source revision, lifecycle state, standing, lineage, and replacement relations.
proof_obligations: Positive: resolve aliases to one canonical object with lifecycle and standing separated.
Negative: detect duplicate identity, stale alias, or lifecycle-standing collapse.
Replay: reproduce identity resolution and historical state at logical time.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: detect duplicate identity, stale alias, or lifecycle-standing collapse.

dimensions.title: GBB and pack composition
dimensions.law: One canonical GBB kernel composes ABB requirements, SBB realizations, bblocks, packs, profiles, and dependency closure.
proof_obligations: Positive: compose a dependency-closed bblock with deterministic BLAKE3 identity.
Negative: refuse conflicting profiles, hidden dependencies, or provider alias ambiguity.
Replay: reproduce ordered composition and exact output inventory.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse conflicting profiles, hidden dependencies, or provider alias ambiguity.

dimensions.title: Architecture contracts
dimensions.law: Provider, consumer, authority, verifier, and operator obligations are machine-readable and generate conformance evidence.
proof_obligations: Positive: generate provider obligations and independent consumer tests from one contract.
Negative: refuse promotion with missing contract evidence or incompatible consumer behavior.
Replay: regenerate contract artifacts and compare exact identities.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse promotion with missing contract evidence or incompatible consumer behavior.

dimensions.title: Baseline, target, and transition planning
dimensions.law: Observed baseline, bounded target, transition states, dependencies, migration, rollback, and proof burden remain explicit.
proof_obligations: Positive: produce a partial-order transition plan with a plan certificate.
Negative: expose unsatisfied goals or conflicting constraints without silently relaxing policy.
Replay: reproduce candidate set, rejected reasons, selected plan, and rollback.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: expose unsatisfied goals or conflicting constraints without silently relaxing policy.

dimensions.title: Portfolio economics and capacity
dimensions.law: Investment, WIP, throughput, lead time, reuse, cost, risk, and proof burden connect to architecture choices.
proof_obligations: Positive: generate a leverage and capacity report for one capability portfolio.
Negative: expose unowned cost, overloaded WIP, or duplicate investment.
Replay: reproduce measures and decision effects from the same portfolio snapshot.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: expose unowned cost, overloaded WIP, or duplicate investment.

dimensions.title: SLO, resilience, recovery, and rollback
dimensions.law: Services declare SLOs, resilience envelopes, recovery objectives, tests, and rollback evidence.
proof_obligations: Positive: execute and receipt a recovery or rollback test within the declared envelope.
Negative: refuse promotion with missing recovery evidence or breached envelope.
Replay: reproduce the test coordinate, observed consequence, and receipt chain.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse promotion with missing recovery evidence or breached envelope.

dimensions.title: Security, classification, and retention
dimensions.law: Data and service classifications generate access, encryption, segmentation, retention, deletion, and evidence obligations.
proof_obligations: Positive: project controls and tests from an admitted classification.
Negative: refuse a deployment or data flow violating classification or retention law.
Replay: reproduce the control family and conformance evidence.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse a deployment or data flow violating classification or retention law.

dimensions.title: Supplier and third-party governance
dimensions.law: Supplier components, licenses, attestations, support, concentration risk, and replacement constraints are explicit.
proof_obligations: Positive: admit a supplier realization with current evidence and exit conditions.
Negative: refuse an expired, unsupported, or untraceable third-party dependency.
Replay: reproduce supplier closure and replacement impact.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse an expired, unsupported, or untraceable third-party dependency.

dimensions.title: Evidence ledger, standing, and promotion
dimensions.law: Claims bind exact coordinates to append-only evidence, typed standing, proof-bearing gates, and replay.
proof_obligations: Positive: promote an exact-head candidate with same-object multi-surface evidence.
Negative: refuse stale-head, duplicate replay, missing evidence, or self-certified promotion.
Replay: independently verify receipt identity, ordering, consequence, and state preservation.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse stale-head, duplicate replay, missing evidence, or self-certified promotion.

dimensions.title: Brokered actuation, operational feedback, and self-evolution
dimensions.law: Autonomics emit intents; BRCE owns DO; runtime consequence becomes admitted evidence and architecture change input.
proof_obligations: Positive: traverse diagnosis through intent, grant, actuation, observation, receipt, and revised architecture.
Negative: refuse direct actuation, ambient authority, missing telemetry, or unreceipted consequence.
Replay: reproduce causal OCEL order and the architecture revision decision.
dimensions.standing_rule: All three obligations must close at the same exact coordinate.
dimensions.falsifier: refuse direct actuation, ambient authority, missing telemetry, or unreceipted consequence.

nonclaims: APS did not execute the ggen enterprise-architecture implementation while admitting this profile.
Stage 5 is a ggen extension and is not attributed to the original RWR maturity model.
No operating model is preferred without admitted enterprise requirements.
No production actuation authority is granted.
Cloud provider profiles receive standing independently.
Generated views, code, policy, and tests are projections rather than authority.
A theorem does not automatically establish deployed-system correspondence.
named_falsifier: A material change cannot be traversed through the same object identities from strategy and operating model to capability, realization, transition, work order, artifact or intent, independent verification, execution grant, observed consequence, receipt, replay, and architecture revision.
